async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Use the searchbox to filter for the project 'kkroening/ffmpeg-python'
    searchbox = page.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Filter by name")
    await searchbox.fill("kkroening/ffmpeg-python")
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Wait for search results to load

    # Step 2: Click on the project link if it appears after filtering
    # Look for a heading with the exact project name and then the link within it
    project_heading = page.get_by_role("heading", name="kkroening / ffmpeg-python", level=2, exact=True)
    project_link = project_heading.get_by_role("link")
    await project_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # Step 3: Navigate to project settings
    settings_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Settings")
    await settings_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # Step 4: Navigate to the 'Members' section within settings
    members_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Members")
    await members_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # Step 5: Add users 'yjlou' and 'a11yproject' as maintainers
    add_member_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Add member")
    role_dropdown = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Role")
    add_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Add to project")

    users = ["yjlou", "a11yproject"]
    for user in users:
        await add_member_input.fill(user)
        await role_dropdown.select_option("Maintainer")
        await add_button.click()
        await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)  # Wait for the action to complete

    # Step 6: Verify the users have been added by checking the members list
    for user in users:
        member_entry = page.get_by_role("row", name=user)
        if await member_entry.count() > 0:
            print(f"User {user} added successfully.")
        else:
            print(f"User {user} might not have been added.")
